description: Simulated gaussian data with missing values (NA) in y, x, z1, zf and the weights w; the levels f = e and zf = q occur only in rows with a missing value. Planted split at z1 = 5, then on zf.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 500L
    d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), f = factor(sample(c("d", "b", "a", "c"), n, replace = TRUE), levels = c("d", 
        "b", "a", "c", "e")), z1 = runif(n, 0, 10), zf = factor(sample(c("k", "j", "m"), n, replace = TRUE), 
        levels = c("k", "j", "m", "q")), w = sample(1:3, n, replace = TRUE))
    left <- d$z1 <= 5
    km <- d$zf %in% c("k", "m")
    eff <- c(d = 0, b = 0.5, a = -0.5, c = 1)[as.character(d$f)]
    d$y <- unname(ifelse(left, 1 + 2 * d$x, ifelse(km, -1 + 0.5 * d$x, 0.5 - d$x)) + eff) + rnorm(n)
    holes <- matrix(sample(n, 40L), nrow = 8L)
    d$y[holes[, 1L]] <- NA
    d$x[holes[, 2L]] <- NA
    d$z1[holes[, 3L]] <- NA
    d$zf[holes[, 4L]] <- NA
    d$w[holes[, 5L]] <- NA
    d$z1[holes[1L, 1L]] <- NA
    d$w[holes[1L, 2L]] <- NA
    d$f[holes[1:3, 1L]] <- "e"
    d$zf[holes[1:3, 2L]] <- "q"
    d
}
